decisions.reason: As a core safety shoe line that gained its own page in 2024, it fits the firm’s strategic innovation path and visible commitment makes withdrawal unlikely.
This comfort insole has only limited visibility, but as a complementary product to the core footwear business the firm is likely to continue it rather than reverse course so soon after launch.
This supportive insole remains only lightly promoted, yet its close link to the firm’s footwear offering and the tendency to justify recent product investments favor retention.

The ergonomic safety shoe series has had dedicated presentation throughout and is highly aligned with the firm’s publicly stated focus on footwear innovation, so management is very unlikely to drop it.
The firefighter and rescue boots moved from a mention to a dedicated page, signaling rising commitment and making continuation more likely despite their more specialized niche.
The moulded insole has sustained home-page visibility and a concrete reference result, so both public commitment and evidence of market use strongly support keeping it.
